items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the real property tax law, in relation to authorizing certain taxing jurisdictions to permit individuals to have real property taxes automatically deducted from such individual's bank accounts
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S4081

 TITLE OF BILL :

An act to amend the real property tax law, in relation to authorizing
certain taxing jurisdictions to permit individuals to have real
property taxes automatically deducted from such individual's bank
accounts

 PURPOSE :

This bill will give localities the ability to provide individual
taxpayers with the option to have their real property tax payments
automatically deducted from their bank account

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section 1. Adds a new section 925-e to the real property tax law to
allow any taxing jurisdiction which has the authority to impose and
collect property taxes to have the option to authorize individuals to
have real property taxes automatically deducted from such individual's
bank accounts.

Section 2. Effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :

This bill will provide individuals with the convenience, should they
choose, to have their property taxes automatically deducted from their
bank account. Many residents already use this method to easily pay
their insurance, utilities and other bills.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

2013-14: S1205/A7997 - Passed Senate/Real Property Taxation Committee
2012: S6963 - Local Government Committee

 LOCAL FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

To be determined.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect on the one hundred twentieth day after
shall have become a law.

summary: Authorizes certain taxing jurisdictions to permit individuals to have real property taxes automatically deducted from such individual's bank accounts.
